lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a semi-rectilinear grid posterior to the gill region, with spatial density decreasing towards the ventral margin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form localized high-luminance nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, each exhibiting a high-contrast transition from a light dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Disorganized distribution of high-luminance blobs visible on the proximal and medial surface of the first dorsal fin, bounded by the truncated distal margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant truncation/amputation of the distal portion of the first dorsal fin, characterized by a ragged, non-uniform superior edge. Small irregular depigmented marking on the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-frequency distribution of small, point-like luminance maxima on the dorsal surface of the right pectoral fin, distinct from the larger macro-spotting on the primary trunk.
